fresh_control.rule: New-source BASE against EX044004 original all economic and original observed fields exact0; publish independent control PASS gate before either active profile.

identity: Authenticate each immutable account/result, parameter enum, source/payload/runtime closure, public source/review lock, actual prepared assets and original requests/input cutoff/fingerprint/causal clock/pricing identity. Retain every actual SUCCEEDED/FAILED/UNKNOWN and retry; no optional economic stopping.
finance: Audit every original fullwindow daily cash/quantity/wealth bridge, integer lots, fees, actual orders/fills/trades, pending/expiry/entry/reservation and actual funded D holding alignment. Reuse corrected exact original public resolve_fill return; never reintroduce float fill<=limit shortcut or add epsilon. Public prepared fetch only readonly; no raw export.
own_feedback: Match actual positive-funded BUY-to-SELL cycle by D, actual quantities and both-side proportional fees; compare strict sign of perunit expression, actual cycle net cash, original CLOSED trade and runtime completed sign without epsilon.
Actual SELL executed on D may arm then consume at same D close if original entry eligibility and reservation permit; SELL intent or unfilled SELL cannot complete a cycle.
Each new policy uses its own real completion history. No frozen BASE next-cycle outcomes feed a new policy.

One matching completion arms once, first original eligible flat D consumes once and sets reservation=i+11. Slot has no actual entry/deadline/order/fill/quantity/fee/trade return. Persistent last sign never rearms.
Actual BUY keeps deadline=i+9/reservation=i+10, failed BUY keeps original reset and does not complete/arm; inherited SELL pending and mandatory deadline remain highest priority.
No next-E success/price/Close test decides whether to consume a slot; missed failed opportunities remain possible.
Original market-only features, positive shock, cost stop, support and ENTRY_GRACE remain unchanged; audit priority from current actual inventory.
divergence: first_original_state_divergence_D from all original fields including reservation
prefix: Original-column prefix exact until first original-state D; actual economic prefix independently exact through that D where applicable. Metadata differences are not economic differences. Compare complete economic and funded path hashes separately.

economics.window: Original complete2020-25, all already-seen development;2026 original technical/control tail only.
economics.annual_denominator: Each profile uses its own actual previous year closing equity, never common original2025 opening or first session close.
economics.hard_goals_unchanged: If same executable buyhold yearreturn>0, return>=1.5*buyhold; otherwise return>0. Annual MDD strictly below buyhold, include year opening. Original closed/sessions*60>=3 fullwindow frequency.
economics.report: Each year return/drawdown/original target gap; count original annual passes; continuous initial100000 through2025 and development through2024, actual end cash/inventory/pending; completeyear frequency separately diagnostic.
economics.limits: No added CI/sample-count/nonharm/stability gate; no independent heldout claim; no additive deletion-of-original-trades estimate or causal information/timing share.

failure_rule: Preserve all technical failures and halt dependent dispatch until diagnosed. Correct an independently bound audit expression only with a retained predecessor and precise public-contract evidence; do not alter source/account/contract silently.
